svg.text: Arista EVPN-VXLAN · 3 data centers · managed by SaltStack
12 Arista vEOS switches + IOSv edge · eBGP underlay /31 · eBGP EVPN on Lo0 · VTEP on Lo1 · symmetric IRB, VRF gold (L3VNI 100001) · anycast GW MAC 00:1c:73:00:00:99
DC1 · Primary fabric · EVPN domain 1:1 · eBGP underlay /31 · spines = EVPN route servers
OOB VRF MGMT 192.168.1.0/24 to every device
Underlay eBGP /31 (spine ↔ leaf), EVPN over Lo0
Internet edge · VRF gold default route
MAC-VRF Lo0:VLAN, RT VLAN:VNI · IP-VRF Lo0:1
multihop 1000 ms × 3 on all EVPN sessions
transit via DC1 (VRF-lite ↔ Type-5 at the hub)
